First, convert 24 weeks and 6 days to days:  
24 weeks × 7 days/week = 168 days  
168 days + 6 days = 174 days  

Subtract 174 days from 1501-11-19:  
November has 30 days, so 19 days earlier in November is Nov 1, leaving 18 days to subtract in October.  
174 total days:  
- Subtract 18 days → 1501-11-01  
- Remaining 156 days: go back months.  
1501 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400? 1501 mod 4 = 1, so not leap).  
October: 31 days, September: 30, August: 31, July: 31, June: 30, May: 31, April: 30, March: 31, February: 28, January: 31.  

Count back:  
From Nov 1:  
Oct: 31 days → Oct 1 after 31 days (156-31=125 left)  
Sep: 30 days → Sep 1 after 30 days (125-30=95 left)  
Aug: 31 days → Aug 1 after 31 days (95-31=64 left)  
Jul: 31 days → Jul 1 after 31 days (64-31=33 left)  
Jun: 30 days → Jun 1 after 30 days (33-30=3 left)  
May 31 days: go back 3 days from June 1 → May 29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1501-05-29
